notes.title: Added 3DFX support files for BC3K 2.0
notes.content:
[b]USE AT YOUR OWN RISK - COMPLETELY UNTESTED[/b]

The 3DFX support files are for use with [url=https://dosbox-staging.github.io/]DOSBox Staging[/url]. 

Run the [b]install_extras.exe[/b] file located in the game's install folder. This will install the .\EXTRAS folder containing the DOS games.

See [b].\Extras\README_EXTRAS.PDF[/b] for additional info. Info on running the 3DFX build is located in the [b]RUNNING BC3K/BC3K20 IN DOSBOX[/b] section.

Supported 3DFX drivers are located in the [b].\Extras\BC3K20\DRIVERS\[/b] folder which contains a [b]README.TXT[/b] file with additional info about the drivers.

Use [b]BC3K3DFX.BAT[/b] to run the 3DFX version.

[Supported 3DFX Cards]

[list]
[*]Voodoo
[*]Voodoo2
[*]Voodoo3
[*]Voodoo5
[*]Voodoo Banshee
[*]Voodoo Rush
[/list]
